title: Maximum overshadowing of an adjoining property (Table 3.8a)
text: In climate zones 4, 5, and 6, development is designed that its shadow cast at midday, 21 June (refer Figure 3.8a) onto any other adjoining property and/or diagonally adjacent lot (refer Figure 3.8b) does not exceed the limits set out in Table 3.8a. Table 3.8a Maximum overshadowing (percentage of dwelling site area): Adjoining property: R25 and lower 25%; R30-R40 35%; R50-60 50%.

exceptions.label: C3.8.2 narrow adjoining lot (R40+, frontage 7.5 m or less): Table 3.8b governs

notes: diverges: from ch3 C3.9.1; the C3.9.2 single-storey exemption is removed because this chapter has none (3.8 is C3.8.1 to C3.8.3 only, p42-43), so the storeys and wall-height inputs are dropped. Narrow-lot exception relabelled C3.8.2 (Table 3.8b). Shadow as % of the adjoining site area at NGL; dividing fences up to 2 m do not contribute (Figure 3.8c). Footnote 1: per grouped dwelling site area excluding common property where the adjoining site is a grouped development (not encoded). Adjoining lots coded R80+ have no row in Table 3.8a (NOT_APPLICABLE).

verified.note: Table 3.8a prints three rows only (R25 and lower, R30-R40, R50-60); no R80+ row and no single-storey exemption in this element. Footnote 1 (per grouped dwelling site area excluding common property) not encoded. The narrow-lot exception keeps its own verify flag.
